title: Development of an impedimetric aptasensor for Shiga-like toxin 1 using a DNA aptamer and an interdigitated microelectrode
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,4590-4601

Life-threatening diarrheal disease caused by Shiga toxin-producing E. coli demands rapid, sensitive, portable, and low-cost diagnostics to enhance on-site food safety monitoring, improve prognosis, and enable timely therapeutic intervention.
